title: [GMCP 203.016.06] Operations and evidence: First-class extension framework and extension governance
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-016-06. Ship inspectable CLI, TUI or API state, configuration validation, bounded metrics/logs/traces, diagnostics, examples, migration and rollback guidance, incident runbooks, and reproducible evidence artifacts. Automate drift detection so a changed dependency or standard invalidates stale proof. Vector outcome: Namespaced MCP extensions can be discovered, negotiated, configured, versioned, isolated and disabled through one typed framework without forking core protocol code. Unknown extensions round-trip safely, required unsupported extensions fail explicitly, official and experimental status is visible, collision and downgrade rules are enforced, and a watch process opens roadmap work for every newly published official extension. Done means production-path tests and retained evidence prove this work package; task closure or roadmap wording alone is not evidence.
